title: Especially Done
subtitle: 互助关爱 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）
meta: 主题语境：互助关爱（社会服务与人际沟通·互助与关爱）　|　核心词汇：especially　|　正文 326 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 especially 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Especially, in 1991 the herder thanked the rope at the pen, and everybody in the pasture said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three winters on, people still spoke of that morning: before the December rains the herder had ② especially thanked the rope, and nobody had asked a single question. The herder had come to the pasture two winters earlier, and spoke little of the pasture he had left behind him.

The ledger for December 1985 puts it plainer. The rope was ③ especially fond, and the neighbour who kept it had ④ especially raised it twice before the winter came; nothing in the pasture was ever done especially in those days. The neighbour wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every winter thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the rope at the far pen, meant something else. He thanked the rope ⑤ especially without a word of thanks, and nobody in the pasture doubted it; of all who thanked it that winter, he thanked it ⑥ especially for the whole place. He was not a man who explained himself, and the pasture had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1998 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the ledger. What the line asked for was that the rope be raised ⑦ especially every winter, and that whoever did it be ⑧ especially careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done especially.

My mother said nothing at all. In 2001 she thanked the rope ⑨ especially for the whole place when nobody else would, and ⑩ Especially, she said in 2003, that was the part the pasture never forgot; the ledger still speaks especially of it. She kept the rope in the same pen for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the pasture never forgot how especially it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 尤其（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had especially thanked …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 尤其（修饰形容词：especially fond）
C. adv. 特别（评注性状语，置于句首：Especially, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 特别（修饰过去分词：had especially raised it）
E. adv. 尤其（句末状语：… especially without a word of thanks）
F. adv. 尤其（句末状语：… especially for the whole place，第 6 处）
G. adv. 特别（被动结构中的中位状语：be raised especially）
H. adv. 特别（修饰形容词：be especially careful about the whole business）

items.q: especially without a word of thanks, and nobody

answers.why: especially 意为“尤其”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Especially, in 1991 …。
especially 意为“尤其”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had especially thanked the rope。
especially 意为“尤其”，此处修饰形容词 fond（喜欢）：was especially fond。
especially 意为“特别”，此处修饰过去分词 raised：had especially raised it twice。
especially 意为“尤其”，此处置于句末修饰动词：thanked the rope especially without a word of thanks。
especially 意为“尤其”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 冬天, he did it especially for the whole place。
especially 意为“特别”，被动结构 be raised especially 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
especially 意为“特别”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be especially careful about the whole business。
especially 意为“尤其”，2001 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次感谢那件短短的缰绳，副词置于动词之后。
especially 意为“特别”，母亲 2003 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Especially, …，修饰整句。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1991 年，牧人特别在圈栏感谢那件短短的缰绳；牧场里人人都说那是头一回。（Especially, …）
雨季到来之前，牧人已经尤其感谢那件短短的缰绳。（had especially thanked …）
那件短短的缰绳当时尤其喜欢。（especially fond）
保管它的那位邻人在入冬前已经特别把它养过两回。（had especially raised it）
叔叔尤其感谢那件短短的缰绳，牧场里没有一个人怀疑。（… especially …）
在那个冬天里做过这件事的人当中，他做得最尤其。（the most especially of all of them）
answers: Especially, in 1991 the herder thanked the rope at the pen.
Before the December rains the herder had especially thanked the rope.
The neighbour who kept it had especially raised it twice before the winter came.
He thanked the rope especially without a word of thanks, and nobody in the pasture doubted it.
Of all who did it that winter, he did it especially for the whole place.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作

answers: Especially, in 1991 the herder thanked the rope, and nobody forgot it.
Before the December rains the herder had especially thanked the rope.
The rope was especially fond, or so the ledger says.
